vb_textbox.text: At the start of each game you are given two gnomes to choose from, a brown gnome which could be paired with a red or purple gnome or a green gnome which could be paired with a red or purple gnome. Red and purple gnomes are a team and green and brown gnomes are a team. Choose a gnome colour, say you choose red, as long as the scores for your red and purple gnomes are above 2 keep choosing red and purple gnomes.  When the score becomes 2 or less change to the other team, green and brown gnomes.  Continue to do this until the game is finished.
